text_block_list.text: A few days after the Kikuka Sho...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've made a decision.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Meet me in an hour. I'll send the location
to your
cell phone.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ding! ♪
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My screen lights up and I see where she
wants me
to go.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer. Are you
prepared for this?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We're about to go on a journey worthy
of a
king—one which ends in becoming
first-rate.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that Umamusume running today?
Why's
she here though?
text_block_list.name: Regular Spectator

text_block_list.text:
That's not just some Umamusume! That's
the nepo
baby! She ran in the Kikuka
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Gossipy Fan

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right. Hmm? I don't
remember hearing
about her running...
text_block_list.name: Regular Spectator

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the spectators are gathering. The
bait is
working.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What I need to aim for is...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Whoa! The nepo baby! She's really here?
text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist

text_block_list.text:
I found her! I'll be the first to get her on
record!
text_block_list.name: Paparazzi

text_block_list.text:
I can see it now! "Nepo Baby Runs Amok
in Her
Signature Racewear!" It'll go
perfectly with the
latest news about her
mother.
text_block_list.name: Paparazzi

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! The media's all here!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's time for my media greeting
routine!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, don't act like you don't
remember. Come
on!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, are you surprised? This is my new
call and
response routine for greeting
the media!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's why you need to remember the
chant too!
When I ask "What's my
name?", you answer with
"King!"
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Come now, we don't have time. It's
showtime for
my adoring public!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What's my naaame?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: She's the smartest of them all, and?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Tch! And the wisest! So naturally...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: She's first-rate and admired by everyone!

text_block_list.text:
That's right! And who stands on top of
the world?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The fastest! The strongest! She walks her
own
path! The one and only first-rate...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: The crowd mutters among themselves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what was that? A... self
introduction?
text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not bad! Not bad! I love that kind
of thing!
text_block_list.name: Paparazzi

text_block_list.text:
Attention, all the media gathered here!
Prepare
for a special announcement
concerning my next
objective!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I will take first place in the
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Takamatsunomiya?! But that's a sprint!
What
happened to your plan for the
Classics?!
text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist

text_block_list.text:
A sudden change of course! Wow! This
will be a
great topic for our lunchtime
talk show!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Please! This is not your ordinary change
in plans.
My path was like this from the
beginning.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But what about your mother's fans?
Surely they'll
be disappointed.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I have nothing to do with my
mother's fan
base. I walk my own path,
with my own fans.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The past is the past, and now is now. I
must rid
myself of unnecessary bindings.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I have my own strength, and that's more
than
enough.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Why, you ask? Because I'm a first-rate Umamusume! But I won't stop there—I'll surpass everything and everyone to become a super first-rate Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Super first-rate?
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Well then, please, tell us! What made
you decide
to run in the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
How about... to herald the coming of
spring
before the spring Tenno Sho?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Huh? What does that even mean? Seems
rather
impulsive to me.
text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, have I piqued your interest?
Come now,
ask me all your questions.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm granting all of you the right to an
interview!
Ohohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало proudly makes her
announcement much
to the frustration
and fascination of the crowd of

reporters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her triumphant, trademark laugh,
she
readies herself to deviate from the
conventional
path which brought her
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Can you get to
preparing my
new training schedule for
sprints right away?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: You've got a lot of work ahead of you.

text_block_list.text:
Of course. After making such a
declaration, I'm
prepared to even crawl
through mud if I have to.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
One might say I'm doing a complete
one-eighty
now that I've finished the
Triple Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But even despite the sudden change in
route, I'm
about to stand on the grand
G1 stage.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone will have their own
opinions.
People will want to compare
me to Спешл Уик,
who doesn't go
against the grain.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But I won't quit now—not when I haven't
even
tried yet.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll keep putting in the effort to walk my
own
path.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No matter what perils are ahead of me,
I'll be the
one laughing victoriously at
the end.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's give it our all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало is running faster than ever
before, and
our next objective becomes
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
